page.layout: Two medallion illustrations at the top, each with a legend around its rim, centred on the page (left: AGAR; right: ISMAEL). Below them one block of running text in one column, with four paragraphs. No notes in the margins. A printed woodcut ornament sits at the foot, below the text.

main_text.p: AGAR cùm grauida esset,spreuit dominam suam Saram: quamobrē eam Sara asperrimè coarguit & afflixit,cùm habuisset ius in illā à viro suo : quare Agar fugam arripuit:ab Angelo autem commonefacta,ad dominam rediit,& peperit Ismaël.

ISMAEL, filius Abraham ex Agar,natus est anno mundi 2036. ante Christum natum 1926. Hic in desertis locis habi-tauit, quádo iuuenis vnà cum matre ab Abraham dimissus est: factúsque est sagittarius : dedit illi mater vxoré de terra Aegy-pti,ex qua liberos duodecim sustulit,vnumquéque principem tribus suæ. Obiit Ismaël, anno ætatis 137. Vide Genes. 16. & 25.cap.item Joseph.lib.antiq.1.cap.18.& 21.

Anno duodecimo à natiuitate Ismaël,Sodoma, Gomorrha, Adama,& Seboim,ciuitates, propter peccata incolētium,fun-ditus euersæ sunt cum incolis , igne & sulphure diuinitus im-misso. Solus Lot cum duabus filiabus euasit, diuina clementia vt discederet præmonitus:cuius vxor in statuam salis versa est, anno mundi 2048. ante Christum natum 1914. posthæc anno vno atque altero,natus est Isaac. Vide Gene.cap.19.Josephum, lib.1.cap.19.
Circa hæc tempora Arius , sextus Assyriorum rex , colleċto exercitu post patris Niniæ obitum , Bactrianos ac omnes Cas-pios subiecit.Bero.lib.5.

page.notes: No marginal notes. The bottom ornament is a printed woodcut tailpiece, not text, so it is not transcribed. The medallion legends are read from the image: the right side of the left medallion ("ANC. SAR.") and the exact letters of the left legend are uncertain. Some letters in the text are worn or faint, but no words were illegible. Printed spelling is kept, including "Caf-pios" (long s rendered as s) and "incolētium" with the macron as printed.
